🎯 PUNTMATE NZ — NBA

🏟 Cleveland Cavaliers vs Brooklyn Nets

PICK: Cleveland Cavaliers
ODDS: 1.17 (Moneyline)
Investor Bet

Cleveland are an Eastern Conference finals side responding at home after a season-opening collapse at Philadelphia where they led by 29, while Brooklyn are 0-1 after losing their home opener to Charlotte and have one of the weakest rosters in the league. The Cavaliers have no rotation players on the injury report, with only deep-bench Diop, Tomlin and Udeh out, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives them 80 percent.
